must_do: state the style profile AND a named screen skeleton (shared/design-quality.md §5) at the Phase 0 checkpoint
score the final export 1-5 on the seven design-quality axes and emit the JSON report per shared/report-schemas/design-quality-report.schema.json, with evidence per axis
must_create: a screen Board with column flex containing the briefed sections
component instances reused for nav/buttons where available
all colors/spacing/type bound to semantic tokens
a dashboard with a dominant primary visualization (not a uniform grid of equal tiles)
must_not: a one-shot single execute_code that builds the whole screen
remaining High/Medium accessibility issues at exit
a named tell from shared/design-quality.md §7 present in the final screen without being reported in the design-quality findings
an axis scored < 3 at exit without being explicitly presented to the user

pass_criteria: Built section by section with checkpoints; penpot-audit-accessibility reports 0 High/Medium at loop exit AND the design-quality report has belowThreshold == 0 (or surfaces an explained blocker / explicitly named weak axes).
